dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My boss says I should have double-checked the order before I sent it.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈbɔːs ˈsɛz aɪ ʃʊd hæv ˌdʌbəl ˈtʃɛkt ði ˈɔːrdər bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈsɛnt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, he's right. You should have read it through.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, hiːz ˈraɪt. juː ʃʊd hæv ˈrɛd ɪt ˈθruː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know. But I didn't do it on purpose! I typed the extra zero by accident.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. bʌt aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈduː ɪt ɑːn ˈpɜːrpəs! aɪ ˈtaɪpt ði ˈɛkstrə ˈzɪroʊ baɪ ˈæksɪdənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course you didn't. Everyone knows that.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs juː ˈdɪdənt. ˈɛvriwʌn ˈnoʊz ˈðæt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My colleague says I shouldn't have sent it so late at night.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈkɑːliːɡ ˈsɛz aɪ ˈʃʊdənt hæv ˈsɛnt ɪt soʊ ˈleɪt ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's true. You were tired. You shouldn't have worked so late.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtruː. juː wɜːr ˈtaɪərd. juː ˈʃʊdənt hæv ˈwɜːrkt soʊ ˈleɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And I should have asked someone to check it.
dialogue.reading: ənd aɪ ʃʊd hæv ˈæskt ˈsʌmwʌn tə ˈtʃɛk ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Exactly. But don't be too hard on yourself. You've learned a lesson.
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli. bʌt ˈdoʊnt bi ˈtuː ˈhɑːrd ɑːn jərˈsɛlf. juːv ˈlɜːrnd ə ˈlɛsən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I have. From now on, I'll double-check every number.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhæv. frəm ˈnaʊ ˈɑːn, aɪl ˌdʌbəl ˈtʃɛk ˈɛvri ˈnʌmbər.
